content: Brazil recurring rails: Pix Automatico entered production June 2025 under BCB Resolution 384/2024 and is the fastest-growing recurring modality in Brazil in 2026. Reported structural failure rate for recurring credit card in Brazil is ~8-14% of attempts vs ~2-5% for Pix Automatico (no credit limit; debits the checking account directly). Bank adoption is still uneven and consumer awareness low, so 2026 guidance is card-first with Pix Automatico offered as a second option and migrated to gradually. Gateways supporting it include Pagar.me, AbacatePay, Asaas, Vindi. Implication for a Brazilian SaaS: card decline rates are materially higher than US benchmarks, so the grace/dunning window matters more and a Pix/boleto fallback is a real retention lever.
